augmentation: Random frequency mask (up to 8 bands) and time mask (up to 16 frames) on the log-mel input.
selection: Epoch with the best balanced accuracy on the validation actors. Test actors are shown per epoch but never used to choose.
narrative: The audio branch trained for 16 epochs on 648 speech clips from actors 01–18. Epoch 12 was kept because it had the best balanced accuracy on validation actors 19–20 (0.90). Test actors 21–24 (144 clips) did not take part in that choice. On them the kept epoch had F1 0.84, balanced accuracy 0.78, specificity 0.73 and recall 0.82. A model that calls every clip distress would get F1 0.80. Distress was the positive class: sad, angry, and fearful. Calm was neutral and calm speech. Happy, surprise, and disgust were left out of the loss. Vision and fusion are drawn in the network view and were not trained in this run.
